selection: every responding river exact information row, including unsupported rows, for all nine original medium-game primary snapshots and both seats
feature_inputs: acting own hole cards, observed five-card board, canonical fixed declared opponent prior; never actual opponent deal, future cards, policy or conditioned beliefs
weighting: chance times fixed opponent reach, normalized over all responding river information rows separately per profile/seat; own past reach excluded; all-zero support has zero cost and no evidence
cost: sum_i w_i max_a Q_i(a) minus sum_refined_groups max_a sum_i w_i Q_i(a); identical legal columns within each original parent
units: chips per counterfactual-weighted river decision; not root EV, exploitability or additive hand loss
limits: Posthoc known single restricted game, three fixed seeds and dependent rows. Fixed own reply suffixes and fixed saved opponent within each snapshot. Static refinement probes, not trained encoders or causal training comparisons. No new training/reference construction, reference strategy input, default change or fresh/global admission. Preserve the failed strength gates and all historical source/data.
